_note: Paraphrases written AFTER the rules, in other words than the 30 main questions: they measure whether the rules generalise. out_of_scope: questions the assistant must refuse. v21-v23 come from the first test by a user: v21 was answered wrongly (a total instead of the comparison), v22 listed only 0 % test emails.

questions.question: nb de campagnes envoyées ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_campaign_kpis

questions.question: on a fait combien de campagnes nationales
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE scope='NATIONAL'

questions.question: taux d'ouverture moyen des campagnes locales
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(open_rate_pct),2) FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE scope='LOCAL'

questions.question: Quelle est la campagne avec le taux de clic le plus élevé ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT name FROM v_campaign_kpis ORDER BY click_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: donne moi le top 3 des campagnes en taux d'ouverture
questions.reference_sql: SELECT name, open_rate_pct FROM v_campaign_kpis ORDER BY open_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Combien de mails délivrés en avril 2026 ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(delivered) FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE send_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND send_date < DATE '2026-05-01'

questions.question: CTOR moyen par périmètre
questions.reference_sql: SELECT scope, ROUND(AVG(ctor_pct),2) FROM v_campaign_kpis GROUP BY scope

questions.question: nombre de désinscrits au total
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(unsubscriptions) FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_campaign_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) = 1)

questions.question: Quelle campagne nationale a le plus faible taux d'ouverture ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT name FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE scope='NATIONAL' ORDER BY open_rate_pct ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: combien de campagnes ont un taux de clic inférieur à 0,5 % ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE click_rate_pct < 0.5

questions.question: Combien de campagnes au second semestre 2026 ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE send_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'

questions.question: taux de clic global des campagnes locales
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(f.clickers)/SUM(f.delivered),2) FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_campaign_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) = 1) f JOIN v_campaign_kpis USING (campaign_id) WHERE scope='LOCAL'

questions.question: Combien de listes de diffusion avons-nous ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_list

questions.question: Nombre d'abonnés de Fictional list 0
questions.reference_sql: SELECT total_subscribers FROM fact_list_size JOIN dim_list USING (list_id) WHERE name='Fictional list 0' ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quelle liste a gagné le plus d'abonnés ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT l.name FROM fact_list_size f JOIN dim_list l USING (list_id) GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY arg_max(total_subscribers, snapshot_date) - arg_min(total_subscribers, snapshot_date) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: délivrés par mois en 2026
questions.reference_sql: SELECT month(send_date), SUM(delivered) FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE year(send_date)=2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Quel est le taux de désinscription moyen en janvier 2026 ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(unsub_rate_pct),3) FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE send_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND send_date < DATE '2026-02-01'

questions.question: Combien de plaintes spam sur les campagnes locales ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(f.complaints) FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_campaign_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) = 1) f JOIN v_campaign_kpis USING (campaign_id) WHERE scope='LOCAL'

questions.question: les 2 campagnes avec le moins de délivrés
questions.reference_sql: SELECT name, delivered FROM v_campaign_kpis ORDER BY delivered ASC LIMIT 2

questions.question: Dernière mise à jour des données : quelle date ?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM fact_campaign_stats

questions.question: est-ce que les campagnes locales font plus de désinscrits que de clics
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(f.unsubscriptions), SUM(f.clickers), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.unsubscriptions > f.clickers), COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_campaign_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) = 1) f JOIN v_campaign_kpis k USING (campaign_id) WHERE k.scope = 'LOCAL'

questions.question: les 5 pires campagnes en taux de clic
questions.reference_sql: SELECT name, click_rate_pct FROM v_campaign_kpis WHERE delivered >= 1000 AND lower(name) NOT LIKE 'test%' ORDER BY click_rate_pct ASC, name LIMIT 5

questions.question: quelle campagne locale a eu le plus de plaintes
questions.reference_sql: SELECT k.name FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_campaign_stats QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) = 1) f JOIN v_campaign_kpis k USING (campaign_id) WHERE k.scope = 'LOCAL' ORDER BY f.complaints DESC, k.name LIMIT 1
